verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI's own docs claim parallel crawling as a high-performance feature. The GitHub README adds multi-URL batch configuration, a browser pool exposed in a monitoring dashboard, and remote CDP browser control for large-scale extraction. Together these cover concurrent scraping at scale, but only as feature-list mentions. missing for 10: detailed docs on concurrency limits or dispatcher/rate controls for many simultaneous sessions, independent or hands-on benchmarks confirming scale.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can spin up many concurrent scraping sessions to gather data at scale

citations.quote: High Performance: Parallel crawling, chunk-based extraction, real-time use cases.
Multi-URL Configuration: Different strategies for different URL patterns in one batch
Real-time Monitoring Dashboard with live system metrics and browser pool visibility
Remote Browser Control: Connect to Chrome Developer Tools Protocol for remote, large-scale data extraction.
